quests.title: The Licensed Lot
quests.premise: A salvage lot on the bench was stolen from a family. The family recognises the lot as theirs. The diving licence behind the lot is genuine.

quests.title: The Second Room
quests.premise: A diver went down a shaft on a line. The diver's lamp came back up the line. The diver did not come back up.

quests.title: Reading the Stones
quests.premise: A council clerk is paid by the season. The clerk keeps the memorial's names weathered until they cannot be read.

quests.title: Tolls on the Swept Circle
quests.premise: A Blackguards cell charges tolls to households without a hist. The tolls are charged for walking the street that those households built.

quests.title: The Record Room
quests.premise: Two centuries of unread customs books would settle a dozen living property claims. A forger inserts pages into the books. A clerk is finally reading the books. The forger works ahead of the clerk.

quests.title: Offerings in the Mouth
quests.premise: The council has ordered the fishers to bring the drowned god ashore. The order blocks the fishers' offering season.

quests.title: The Barge Debt
quests.premise: A councillor lost money at the dice tables. The councillor's gambling debts are being called in as a civic matter.

quests.title: Licensing the Lighters
quests.premise: The council wants the lighter crews licensed. The lighter crews want the tariff opened. Each side wants its offer carried to the other.

quests.title: Escort and Tribute
quests.premise: Lilmoth pays for road escorts. The escorts have started splitting the Naga toll with the Naga. The escorts no longer break the Naga toll.

quests.title: Short of Divers
quests.premise: The lime cutters have lost three free-divers in one season. The lime cutters blame a living creature in the worked steps for the loss of the divers.

quests.title: The Retired Rota
quests.premise: Cheydinhal has sent a claimant for an intake. The retired Shadowscales cannot agree how to award the intake.

quests.title: Rice and Rust
quests.premise: Lilmoth's rice is landing tainted. The taint comes from somewhere along the estate's flood channel.

quests.title: Down to the Hold
quests.premise: Four families have agreed to fund a single cut into the Alessian hull's shut hold. Each family insists on its own watcher. Each watcher observes the other three families.

quests.title: What the Reef Is Saying
quests.premise: The dying reef head over the drake hole has begun sounding at the turn of the tide. The bay pilots have started steering by the sound.

quests.title: Fish in the House Floors
quests.premise: At each spring tide the dead of the drowned hamlet come up through the roofs. The dead go back to their own doors.

quests.title: A Body in the Lot
quests.premise: A corpse surfaces inside a sorted salvage lot. The corpse is weighted with the yard's own licence tags.

quests.title: The Half-Day Detour
quests.premise: The last carter to cut through Ganthil's Rest has not come out. The carter took that route, not the half-day detour.

quests.title: The Keeper's Weather
quests.premise: The council wants a dry harvest fortnight. The council asks a calendar keeper to provide it. The calendar keeper has refused emperors' agents.

quests.title: Three Failing Spans
quests.premise: The junction deck carries more traffic than its timbers can bear. The households split over who pays to cut new timbers.

quests.title: Whoever Relights It
quests.premise: The Topal lantern is dead. Relighting it would decide who profits from the bar. Three parties are each proving the stair unsafe.

quests.title: The Untouched House
quests.premise: A Lilmoth broker is selling deeds to plague-emptied Rockpark houses. No buyer has yet dared enter the houses.

quests.title: The Silt Room
quests.premise: The An-Xileel pumped the xanmeer dry. A survey party has gone into the xanmeer. The survey party is measuring how far returning silt has filled it.

quests.title: Cargo Off the Ledger
quests.premise: Cargo is lightered ashore at night. The cargo is settled at the dice tables, not at the quay.

quests.title: The Sixth Recitation
quests.premise: The six-day recitation needs six speakers. Two of the speakers now work Lilmoth's quay.

quests.title: Grave-Poles for the City
quests.premise: Lilmoth wants its own burial register kept in the city. Xul-Vaat's grave-wrights hold that the register is the trade.

quests.title: What Came Up Belongs
quests.premise: A drowned villa is stripped clean. The stripping happens before its living heirs can lodge a claim. The villa lies on a route that the yard had not licensed.

quests.title: The Beast Ground Ledger
quests.premise: Escort contracts are being written for journeys that the convoys never made. The contracts carry the Naga camp's own signatures.

quests.title: Air on the Slate
quests.premise: The slate at Breathing-Stone lists a diver who went below eleven days ago. The listing is in a hand that the reef cutters do not recognise.

quests.title: The Ball and the Ledger
quests.premise: Lilmoth wants a side in the Teeba-Enoo court. Lilmoth wants to prove that its writ reaches Meerhleel's quay.

quests.title: The Hollow Under the Wall
quests.premise: The root gallery floods to chest height on a week's notice. A resident lives in the gallery. The resident will not come out.

quests.title: Sees-No-Root's Egg
quests.premise: A mnemic egg was lost with a village's tree. The egg is rumoured to be in a root gallery two rivers away.

quests.title: Licences for a Burnt Hinterland
quests.premise: Soulrest's surviving provincial offices still issue licences. The licences cover a hinterland that burned two centuries ago.

quests.title: Three Claims on a Harbour
quests.premise: Three parties hold defensible title to the same deep-water landfall. The tariff argument has moved out of the Long Table and into the street.

quests.title: Books of the Bench
quests.premise: The harbour office wants the salvage yard's books. Every lot in the books is a shipper's lost cargo.

quests.title: The Last Imperial Hull
quests.premise: The supply of Legion transports is finished. The breaking yard must decide what it is for next.

quests.title: The False Light
quests.premise: A century of wrecks on the Long Bar could be proved deliberate. Proof would force the harbour office to act.

quests.title: Licensed and Disowned
quests.premise: Soulrest licenses the anchorage in one ledger. Soulrest denies the anchorage in another ledger. A Khajiit master wants the matter settled in writing.

quests.title: Whatever the Sea Lost
quests.premise: Goods from a wreck are on sale at Chasepoint. The owners do not yet know that the ship is down.

quests.title: The Price the Legion Set
quests.premise: The Fourth Stage still charges an Imperial rate for its well. The road's carters have stopped paying the rate.

quests.title: Hired to Go Upriver
quests.premise: The ferry family are hired upriver far more often than traffic explains. Their last party has not returned.

quests.title: Four Parties, One Sill
quests.premise: Four parties contest the gravel sill. One of the four has begun moving stone in the channel at night.

quests.title: Sell Early and Low
quests.premise: Mudfoot has found a way to prove something about Soulrest's cockle price. Soulrest sets the cockle price before the boats land.

quests.title: Owed Labour on the Sea Wall
quests.premise: People rebuild the salt walls each spring. They are working off an Owing that does not fall.

quests.title: A Pack Under the Threshing Floor
quests.premise: The abandoned plantation is still roofed. The plantation is still worth salvaging. A creature has denned beneath its floor.

quests.title: The Gate Warning
quests.premise: A warning at Ashroot's gate says that the burn-country jungle kills people who walk it alone. A Soulrest survey went into that jungle.

quests.title: Five Centuries of Stock
quests.premise: The plague town holds five centuries of untouched stock. The first crew into the stock came back changed.

quests.title: Four Miles Away
quests.premise: A Colovian heir has arrived. The heir holds the deed to a great house. The neighbouring families burned the house.

quests.title: The Cordon Cellars
quests.premise: The prison's cordon cellars were sealed. The occupants were still on the roll when the cellars were sealed.

quests.title: Ninety Minutes of Tide
quests.premise: A pilot has begun marking the channel mouth. The channel mouth is navigable for ninety minutes at the top of the tide.

quests.title: Pilots or Customs
quests.premise: The Blackguards want Bramman's river opened as a road. Soulrest wants the river declared a customs matter. The pilots want the river forgotten.

quests.title: The Taking Rules
quests.premise: A licensed buyer has offered to break the egg-takers' rules. The offer is at a scale beyond any Soulrest law.

quests.title: Buying the Unmaking
quests.premise: A collector has paid for this year's clay wraxu. The collector paid before the Clutch can destroy the wraxu.

quests.title: Whose Lot Is Whose
quests.premise: The breaking yard has started buying Long Bar wrecks without asking questions. The wrecks carry ironwork that the divers' yard recognises.

quests.title: Contracted at the Long Table
quests.premise: A crew was hired in the least private room in the port. The crew sails and is not seen again. Every witness remembers a different master.

quests.title: The Salt Year
quests.premise: A wet-season overtop has spoiled the salt pans and the cockle flat together. Each side blames the other's works.

quests.title: The Coast Road Survey
quests.premise: A road survey east of Soulrest went out to price a causeway repair. The survey stopped sending its stages back.

quests.title: The Stage That Was Not Paid
quests.premise: Two families each claim to be the Legion's unpaid stage-keeper. Each claim rests on two centuries of arrears.

quests.title: Silt from the Burn Country
quests.premise: River silt is turning the reef head over the drake hole to rubble. The rubble makes the bar deadlier every season.

quests.title: The Anchorage Ledger
quests.premise: Cargo landed at Quin'rawl is entered at the Long Table. The entry records that the cargo came by road.

quests.title: A Grave for a Foreigner
quests.premise: A Soulrest merchant's will asks for a Xul-Vaat pole. Both the register and his heirs object.

quests.title: The Ration Argument Breaks Down
quests.premise: The villages ration the glowing harvest by an argument. The argument has finally broken down.

quests.title: What the Salvage Coast Owes
quests.premise: Survivors pulled off the bar have been kept as salvage crew. The survivors work off the cost of their own rescue.

quests.title: The Weather Petition
quests.premise: Soulrest's council has begun buying the keeper's succession. The council no longer asks the keeper for weather.

quests.title: A Side in the Court
quests.premise: The port's Teeba-Enoo side is short two players. A convincing win would be a diplomatic problem.

quests.title: Robbed on Meerhleel's Quay
quests.premise: Meerhleel's whole advantage is that the harbour staff ask no questions. A merchant robbed on its quay has no authority that hears complaints.

quests.title: The Raft Quarter Rent
quests.premise: The warehouse row has begun charging the Argonian raft quarter. The charge is for the water beneath its rafts.

quests.title: Sugar Moved North
quests.premise: Moon-sugar used to land untaxed at Moonmarch. The moon-sugar now arrives at Lilmoth. Lilmoth's council has noticed it.

quests.title: The Gazetteer's One Name
quests.premise: An Imperial gazetteer clerk is being paid. The clerk is to strike the province's single Khajiiti place-name from the next edition.

quests.title: Poling Water
quests.premise: A cargo must go above the last supplied bed on the Keel-Sakka. The polers have refused that reach.

quests.title: Lights Under the Pilgrim Road
quests.premise: The fen has begun lighting in a pattern that the night pilgrims can read. Each village reads the pattern differently.

quests.title: Digging at the Far End
quests.premise: An unknown digger has been working at the far terrace of the dry crown. Four villages bury their dead on the crown.

quests.title: No Village Will Yield an Inch
quests.premise: The burial crown is out of terrace. Each of its four sectors prefers to bury badly. No sector will give up ground.

quests.title: Who Stocked the Bench
quests.premise: A stocker kept the air chamber's bench supplied for thirty years. The stocker stopped this season.

quests.title: The Last Hist Before the Burn
quests.premise: Ashroot shelters whoever reaches it. Its sheltering rite has begun to fail on the burn-country side.

quests.title: Walked It Alone
quests.premise: Three people from the plantation ignored Ashroot's gate warning. They did so in one season.

quests.title: Tapped Past Bearing
quests.premise: Ashroot's tree is drawn on harder each year. The tree shelters refugees from the burn country.

quests.title: Six Days, Four Speakers
quests.premise: Sees-No-Root's recitation needs six speakers. The village can field four speakers.

quests.title: The Pulled Field
quests.premise: A vandal pulled the grave-poles out of the burial field. No record remains to match a pole to its grave.

quests.title: Rice and Tenancy
quests.premise: Lilmoth depends on Hereguard rice. The dependence gives the tenants a hold over Lilmoth. The Breton family now feels that hold.

quests.title: Hired From Outside
quests.premise: The estate pays outsiders in coin. The estate pays its tenants in credit. The estate's books do not add up.

quests.title: The Early Flood Channel
quests.premise: The estate's oldest flood channel fills a fortnight before the river does. The Breton steward cannot name the reason.

quests.title: Where the Writ Stops
quests.premise: Bright-Throat's chime-relay reaches the platform village. Lilmoth's writ does not reach the platform village. A cargo is moving through the gap.

quests.title: The Poler's Rate
quests.premise: The polers have set one rate for the whole river. The platform village's boat-owners will not honour the rate.

quests.title: Above the Supplied Bed
quests.premise: A creature has denned in the outer root galleries upriver. It has started coming down to the platform village.

quests.title: Cockles Before Dawn
quests.premise: The village's early boats are being emptied on the flat. The boats are emptied before they reach the Soulrest buyers.

quests.title: A Dry Floor, No Questions
quests.premise: The cheapest bed on Topal Bay takes whoever pays. One guest left a body under its boards.

quests.title: The Register in Duplicate
quests.premise: Xul-Vaat keeps its burial register twice over, in two copies. The two copies have begun to disagree about who is buried.

quests.title: Branching Round the Gaps
quests.premise: Walks-The-Mangrove is branching new walkway around its failing spans. The households left behind want their sections rebuilt.

quests.title: Two Miles of Deck
quests.premise: An unknown walker uses the dry way through the mangrove after dark. The village walks the way in daylight only.

quests.title: The Broker's Price
quests.premise: The price of Bright-Throat's last endorsement was a household's labour. The labour is owed to a creditor outside the village.
